sources.label: Krolak et al., Cell — published online July 16, 2025

research.summary: Yellow parasols unfold across a misty hillside, with distant echoes larger than their origin. Inspired by a mouse study in which arterial endothelial gap junctions help determine how quickly and how far vasodilation spreads after neural activity. Deleting Cx37 and Cx40 impaired distant propagation while local diving-arteriole responses remained. Conceptual art, not a depiction of anatomy.
